answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a domain-separated hash of its task identifier and a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature makes the beacon output unpredictable before publication and publicly verifiable afterward. Commit-reveal binds submissions to that challenge; tags such as plume, vine, and zephyr separate task domains. This blocks advance solution caching and makes offline sybil farming ineffective, though it does not alone prevent identities from joining.
